sources.title: Laya — 33ms Multilingual System 1 Decision Engine
sources.snippet: Instead of staying bitter, I decided to take everything I learned, fix every architectural limitation of the old approach, and build a completely open, horizontal System 1 decision model family: Laya.

sources.title: Laya | AI Pro Playbook
sources.snippet: Laya is an open-weight decision model from Convai Innovations, released September 18, 2026 under the Apache 2.0 license. Like TypeSafe's Jev, it answers typed questions about a ticket, email or document with calibrated probabilities instead of writing text, but it runs on your own hardware, at about 33 milliseconds per decision on a single GPU.
